The first 1.4.0 beta gives you finer control over who can do what. The broad permissions are now split into smaller ones. For servers, editing settings, managing content, schedules, community settings and backup schedules are separate, and editing the YAML covers all of them. For Flytower itself, updates, notifications, integrations, branding and SSH are separate. Inviting people and managing roles are no longer the same thing as managing people. Existing roles keep everything they could do before. The role editor groups permissions by area and marks the powerful ones. It locks the extras a permission brings with it, and it lets you copy any role. **People** can now show exactly what each person is able to do. A server's **Settings** has an **Access** section, so someone with the new **Manage who has access** permission can look after one server's people and invite links without touching the rest.

Chat now goes both ways with Discord. Turn on **Chat from Discord** on the Discord app card under **System, Integrations**, then switch it on for a server in its **Discord chat** settings. Messages in that channel then show in game as `[Discord] name: message`. This needs **Message Content Intent** turned on for your app in the Discord Developer Portal, and the bot added to your Discord server with the new button on the card. The web map also zooms smoothly now. It no longer flashes blank while it zooms or redraws, pinch and trackpad zoom glide, and nearby zoom levels load ahead of time.

The system helper and updater now run the **Rust** versions by default. If the Rust agent fails to start, Flytower falls back to the Bun one by itself and stays on it until the next update. To choose Bun yourself, put `bun` in `/etc/flytower/agent`. This is a beta, so please try it on a test server first. Testing notes are in [testing-1.4.0.md](https://github.com/MattA-Official/mc-panel/blob/v1.4.0-beta.1/docs/testing/testing-1.4.0.md) and [Testing the Rust agent](https://github.com/MattA-Official/mc-panel/blob/v1.4.0-beta.1/docs/testing/testing-rust-agent.md).
